notes: These exact buyer queries are frozen before implementation changes.

Entity names in this bank are benchmark instances, not parser aliases or production vocabulary.

Hard constraints must remain attached to their branch, global exclusions must apply to every branch, and soft preferences must rank without fabricating proof or hiding candidates with missing optional evidence.

cases.query: Show me either a 3BHK in Hoodi under ₹2.4 Cr or a 4BHK on Sarjapur Road under ₹3.2 Cr.
I’ll take a smaller home within 2 km of Bagmane Tech Park, or a larger 4BHK farther away under ₹3 Cr—but not in an under-construction project.
Find a 3BHK under ₹2.7 Cr that is close to both Hoodi Metro and Manipal Hospital, not merely one of them.
Either give me a home within 2 km of Gopalan National School, or one within 1 km of a metro station; keep both options under ₹2.5 Cr.
Compare Godrej Air under ₹2.6 Cr with Godrej Lakeside Orchard under ₹3.1 Cr, but only show 3BHKs in the first and 4BHKs in the second.
I want a ready-to-move 3BHK near a tech park. Prefer a quieter society with stronger reviews, but don’t hide homes just because noise evidence is missing.
Show me SNN Raj Etternia or Prestige Song of the South, unless the available home is above ₹2.8 Cr or still under construction.
If it’s in Electronic City, keep it below ₹1.8 Cr; if it’s on Kanakapura Road, I can stretch to ₹2.4 Cr—but I need a 3BHK either way.
My office is near Bagmane Tech Park and my partner works near Manipal Hospital Whitefield. Find homes with measured distance evidence to both, prioritizing the better-balanced commute.
I liked Godrej Air, but show alternatives: either something closer to Hoodi Metro at a similar price, or a larger home under ₹3 Cr elsewhere. Exclude Godrej Air itself.
